# Visualizations

This folder houses graphical data representations and supplementary charts extracted from the clinical quality database reports. It currently contains a specific visualization tracking the volume of open surgeries over time at the regional level, serving as a visual companion to the broader clinical indicators and regional comparisons documented across the wiki.

## Pages

- [[supplerende-graf-med-aaben-kirurgi-over-tid-paa-regionalt-niveau|Supplerende graf med åben kirurgi over tid på regionalt niveau]] — A supplementary chart illustrating the volume and trends of open surgeries over time, broken down by region.
